meta.title: PipeHook — Closed-loop customer engines for the pipe trades
meta.description: PipeHook builds automated diagnostic funnels that fill pipe and plumbing companies’ calendars with qualified inspections and site visits.

hero.sub: We are your Growth Partner. We handle the funnel, the AI follow-up, and the bookings under your brand — so your team gets qualified inspections without learning another piece of software.

difference.title: More control. Better conversations.
difference.body: Most lead programs optimize for volume. We optimize for the one thing that matters: a full schedule of jobs your team actually wants.

benefits.title: Exclusive leads
benefits.text: Every inquiry belongs to your team. Never shared with a competitor down the road.

benefits.title: One flat monthly fee
benefits.text: A predictable growth engine without admin, bidding wars, or pay-per-lead stress.

benefits.title: Active disqualification
benefits.text: We filter out tire-kickers so your technicians spend time on real opportunities.

process.body: One connected system that makes marketing, qualification, and scheduling feel like one conversation.

steps.title: Targeted reach
steps.text: Local ads find homeowners already searching for a permanent fix.

steps.title: Interactive hook
steps.text: A diagnostic quiz turns curiosity into a clear, qualified inspection request.

steps.title: AI booking
steps.text: The right jobs go straight to your technicians’ calendar, around the clock.

regions.title: One region.
regions.body: To guarantee lead quality and completely eliminate shared leads, we only license our system to a single contractor per geographical area. Once a territory is claimed, it’s locked out for your competitors.
